_provenance: SHAPE from fal's FastAPI-style validation errors -- a `detail` array of `{loc, msg, type}` -- which is the documented format for a rejected request body. This exact example is the one to expect if the `seed` disagreement recorded in config/models.json resolves the wrong way: two of fal's own pages disagree about whether seedance takes a seed, fal.mjs sends it, and THIS is what the first live call would return if it should not. 422 is TERMINAL: the same body will be rejected the same way.
